description: This file contains the implementation of the AuthenticationService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for setting user credentials, validating user status, and assigning user attributes during the authentication process.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing user authentication, setting user credentials, and updating user attributes.

methods.name: setCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Validates and sets user credentials if the user is active and not terminated.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Fetches user credentials and delegates setting credentials for the user.

methods.name: setUserAttributes
methods.description: Assigns user attributes to the authenticated user object based on the provided user entity.
